findings.disposition: Partially remediated; add short German-first and English-second explanations for the remaining normative learner and workflow terms without changing scope, order or delivery authority.
findings.evidence: Section 2 now explains Formula, Cell, Recalc, Textoverflow, Range, XML comments, DocFX, TUI and proof paths. Sections 1, 3, 4, 6 and the readiness/prompt blocks still use API, Runtime, A11Y, CEFR B2 and Spec Kit as normative or execution-relevant terms without a first-use explanation for first-year learners.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: After the five residual terms and the minimal Spec Kit handoff are explained bilingually, before Specify or autonomous execution.
